verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Restate can generate an OpenAPI 3.1 spec per service (restate-docs-76) and has admin API docs, but there is no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference/playground on the docs site — in fact the probe explicitly found openapi.json/swagger.json endpoints returning 404 (restate-probe-2). No mention of a Swagger UI, try-it-now console, or embedded runnable examples anywhere in the pack.
